response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), so RET-020 applies. This rule has priority 90, which dominates the out-of-window ineligibility rule RET-008 (priority 10). Final-sale rule RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is False, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present. Defective items are returnable regardless of the standard 30-day window, so despite 48 days since delivery, the return is eligible.
